mission.description: Fly from the base at (6378, -23951) to the destination at (-4046, 19073). The route must pass through the required points A (Washington Hospital Parking Structure Heliport) at (23934, -10288), B (Hayward Executive Airport) at (11269, 1023); visit A before B. Maintain an altitude between 20 and 120 meters at every waypoint. Avoid all restricted zones and obstacles (Z1 [Oakland San Francisco Bay Airport (KOAK, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z2 [San Francisco International Airport (KSFO, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z3 [San Carlos Airport (KSQL, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z4 [Palo Alto Airport (KPAO, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m]), including the straight paths between waypoints. Keep the total horizontal route length at or below 95555 meters. (START is Stanford Health Care West Heliport; DEST is Childrens Hospital Oakland Alternate Heliport.) Coordinates are meters east/north of the region center.
